LIPIKA GUPTA TPRM Analyst | Vendor Risk Management & Supplier Governance � +91 9804163981 | � lipika.gupta25@outlook.com | �Sector 34, Noida, India

Professional Summary

Supplier Relationship Management and Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM) professional with 8+ years of experience in vendor governance, supplier performance management, risk assessments and procurement operations across BFSI, Telecom, and Insurance sectors. Experienced in managing the end-to-end supplier lifecycle, including vendor onboarding, supplier assessments, compliance monitoring, performance governance and DPIA requirements. Proven ability to act as a bridge between Business, Risk, Legal, IT, and Compliance teams, ensuring regulatory compliance, supplier performance oversight, and operational efficiency. Proficient in Process Unity, Coupa, SAP Ariba, Oracle PeopleSoft, and ServiceNow, enabling effective supplier governance, risk visibility, governance reporting.

Technical Skills

Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM), Supplier Governance & Vendor Risk Management (VRM), Supplier Relationship Management (SRM), Vendor Risk Assessments & Due Diligence, Risk Classification & Tiering, Supplier Onboarding & Lifecycle Management, Supplier Performance Management (Scorecards & Reviews), SLA & Business Continuity Plan (BCP) Reviews, Contract Lifecycle Monitoring & Renewals, Compliance Monitoring, DPIA & GDPR Awareness, Issue Remediation Tracking & Reassessments, Governance Reporting & Audit Support, UAT Support for Risk & Onboarding Workflows, SOP Development & Process Documentation, Cross-Functional Stakeholder Coordination.

Tools & Systems

Process Unity | Coupa Risk | SAP Ariba (Downstream) | Oracle PeopleSoft | Supply Wisdom | Hellios | SharePoint | MS Office | Power BI | Familiarity with OneTrust tool

Experience

1. Assistant Manager, BA4 – Barclays, Noida (April 2025 – October 2025)



Facilitated contract reviews and Data Quality Testing (DQT) for 50+ third-party supplier agreements, reducing data accuracy gaps by 15% and ensuring audit-ready documentation.

Validated supplier contracts for ISO controls, BCP, exit strategies, and contractual data accuracy gaps.

Managed end-to-end Supplier Assurance Attestations (SAA) for 50+ third-party suppliers, ensuring alignment with Barclays Risk Utility governance standards and maintained governance dashboards to support internal and external audits. • Conducted supplier due diligence & periodic reassessments, including Financial

Stability Review (FSR) and control assurance reviews.

Collaborated with Procurement, Legal, Risk, Privacy, and Compliance teams to support supplier governance, risk remediation, and contract compliance.

2. Supplier Relationship & TPRM Analyst – Accenture Pvt Ltd, Gurgaon (July 2023-February 2025)

Managed vendor onboardings and risk assessment workflows using Coupa Risk, supporting end-to-end third-party lifecycle management.

Conducted supplier risk assessments and periodic reassessments on IT & Non-IT vendors to support regulatory compliance.

Collaborated with IT, Privacy, Group Resiliency & Compliance on DPIA reviews, risk remediation, and governance activities.

Reviewed vendor contracts, BCP, exit plans, ISO, insurance, and policy documentation



to support supplier governance and service continuity. Supported risk workflow automation, UAT for onboarding & Privacy workflows, and prepared supplier risk dashboards, MIS, and audit documentation.

Soft Skills

Education

Languages

3. Procurement Specialist - MetLife GOSC, Noida (February 2018 – July 2023)



Facilitated third-party risk assessments across operational, financial, reputational, and compliance domains, supporting vendor due diligence and remediation tracking. • Reviewed vendor documentation and contracts including data handling policies, BCP,

ISO certifications, privacy controls, and data protection requirements (GDPR exposure).

Coordinated the DPIA activities for vendors handling personal data, gathering data





flow information and documentation for DPO review and approval. Partnered with cross-functional stakeholders and external vendors to complete vendor due diligence, documentation reviews, sanction screening and issue remediation. Supported vendor management and procurement operations using SAP Ariba (Buyer) and PeopleSoft, managing PR-to-PO processes, onboarding, and transaction workflows for APAC region.

Assisted in ServiceNow portal implementation for APAC processes, supporting streamlined vendor-related workflows.

Maintained supplier inventory, governance documentation, dashboards, and audit- ready records, supporting internal audits, SOP documentation, and compliance reporting.

4. Associate – British Telecom Pvt Ltd, Kolkata

(October 2016 - November 2017)

Managed procurement and Accounts Payable (AP) billing queries and reconciliations,

ensuring accurate and timely vendor payments. Supported PR approvals and PO processing (Buyer role), coordinating with business requestors, sourcing team, and vendors, to ensure smooth PR-to-PO processing. • Resolved vendor escalations and invoice discrepancies, while supporting SLA reporting,



and governance documentation to ensure procurement process compliance.

Stakeholder Coordination | Cross-Functional Communication | Vendor Engagement | Risk Awareness | Attention to Detail | Escalation Handling | Time Management | Ability to Work Under Pressure

B.A. (History Hons.) Scottish Church College, Kolkata – University of Calcutta | 2015

Higher Secondary Auxilium Convent School, Bandel – ISC | 2010

Secondary Auxilium Convent School, Bandel – ICSE | 2008

English, Hindi, Bengali
